topic: Your name is in a thread

slides.headline: Your name is in a Reddit thread. Here's what to do first.
Don't reply under your own name.
slides.body: It confirms who you are and keeps the thread alive.

slides.headline: Screenshot everything.
slides.body: Post, comments, usernames, links and dates. Threads get edited and deleted.

slides.headline: Don't create accounts to defend yourself.
slides.body: Alt accounts break Reddit's rules and get spotted fast.

slides.headline: Posting someone's personal information breaks Reddit's rules.
Don't contact the poster.
slides.body: It almost always ends up as the next post.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
